question.problem:
What are the missing entries in the following truth table?

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A \land B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\phantom{F}}$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\phantom{F}}$ |
question.worked_solution:
The statement $A \land B$ is true if both $A$ and $B$ are true.

The complete truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A \land B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ | $\textrm T$ |
| $\textrm T$ | $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm T$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm F}$ |
| $\textrm F$ | $\textrm F$ | $\bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}\textrm F}$ |
